name: superimg
description: Programmatic video generation — HTML/CSS templates in *.media.ts rendered to MP4, images, GIFs, and SVGs.

interface.longDescription: SuperImg renders TypeScript media definitions into video files. This plugin carries the full authoring lifecycle: brief, design, build, motion craft, review, multi-format variants, ship.
defaultPrompt: Create a SuperImg template that announces a launch
Review my template before I ship it
Export this video for YouTube and Instagram
